targetTexts.1: The apostles and brothers throughout Judea soon heard that the Gentiles also had received the word of God.
targetTexts.2: So when Peter went up to Jerusalem, the circumcised believers took issue with him
targetTexts.3: and said, “You visited uncircumcised men and ate with them.”
targetTexts.4: But Peter began and explained to them the whole sequence of events:
targetTexts.5: “I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision of something like a large sheet being let down from heaven by its four corners, and it came right down to me.
targetTexts.6: I looked at it closely and saw four-footed animals of the earth, wild beasts, reptiles, and birds of the air.
targetTexts.7: Then I heard a voice saying to me, ‘Get up, Peter, kill and eat.’
targetTexts.8: ‘No, Lord,’ I said, ‘for nothing impure or unclean has ever entered my mouth.’
targetTexts.9: But the voice spoke from heaven a second time, ‘Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.’
targetTexts.10: This happened three times, and everything was drawn back up into heaven.
targetTexts.11: Just then three men sent to me from Caesarea stopped at the house where I was staying.
targetTexts.12: The Spirit told me to accompany them without hesitation. These six brothers also went with me, and we entered the man’s home.
targetTexts.13: He told us how he had seen an angel standing in his house and saying, ‘Send to Joppa for Simon who is called Peter.
targetTexts.14: He will convey to you a message by which you and all your household will be saved.’
targetTexts.15: As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell upon them, just as He had fallen upon us at the beginning.
targetTexts.16: Then I remembered the word of the Lord, how He said, ‘John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.’
targetTexts.17: So if God gave them the same gift He gave us who believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I to hinder the work of God?”
targetTexts.18: When they heard this, they had no further objections, and they glorified God, saying, “So then, God has granted even the Gentiles repentance unto life.”
targetTexts.19: Meanwhile those scattered by the persecution that began with Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the message only to Jews.
targetTexts.20: But some of them, men from Cyprus and Cyrene, went to Antioch and began speaking to the Greeks as well, proclaiming the good news about the Lord Jesus.
targetTexts.21: The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number of people believed and turned to the Lord.
targetTexts.22: When news of this reached the ears of the church in Jerusalem, they sent Barnabas to Antioch.
targetTexts.23: When he arrived and saw the grace of God, he rejoiced and encouraged them all to abide in the Lord with all their hearts.
targetTexts.24: Barnabas was a good man, full of the Holy Spirit and faith, and a great number of people were brought to the Lord.
targetTexts.25: Then Barnabas went to Tarsus to look for Saul,
targetTexts.26: and when he found him, he brought him back to Antioch. So for a full year they met together with the church and taught large numbers of people. The disciples were first called Christians at Antioch.
targetTexts.27: In those days some prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.
targetTexts.28: One of them named Agabus stood up and predicted through the Spirit that a great famine would sweep across the whole world. (This happened under Claudius.)
targetTexts.29: So the disciples, each according to his ability, decided to send relief to the brothers living in Judea.
targetTexts.30: This they did, sending their gifts to the elders with Barnabas and Saul.
